description: Give Rove a starting URL and a goal; its agent browses public pages (at most a few) and returns an answer. Each call starts a new paid run, so pass an idempotencyKey (any stable id for this request): retrying with the same key returns the same run instead of charging again. By default waits for the result; if it is still going, the result has status "running" and a runId: then call rove_get_run with waitSec instead of starting another run. Use output_schema for a checked JSON shape, find/maxChars to keep the answer short. Every result has status, retryable and hint fields saying what to do next.

find.description: Only return lines containing any of these words or phrases (case-insensitive), with one line of context each.

idempotencyKey.description: Duplicate-run key (8-200 chars: letters, digits, - _ . :). The same key from the same account within 24 hours returns the existing run instead of starting and charging a new one.

includeLinks.description: Also list links (extract) or the pages visited (runs). Off by default to keep results short.

javascript.description: Let the agent render pages with JavaScript (only on hosts Rove has enabled)

maxChars.description: Return at most this many characters of the answer/page text (200-100000). The result says truncated and totalChars when it was cut.

outputFormat.description: Desired answer format, e.g. "JSON with fields name, price". Defaults to JSON.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the answer's data field; Rove checks the answer against it (one automatic correction).

task.description: What Rove should find or do, in plain language

timeoutSec.description: Maximum seconds to wait when wait=true

url.description: Public http(s) URL to start from

wait.description: Wait for the result (true) or return immediately with the runId (false)

name: rove_run_task

answerTruncated.description: Rove stored only the first part of a very long answer

duplicate.description: An earlier run with the same idempotencyKey was returned; nothing new was charged

hint.description: What to do next, in plain words

matches.description: Matching lines, when find was given

pageCount.description: Pages the agent visited (listed only with includeLinks)

retryAfterSec.description: Seconds to wait before calling again

runStatus.description: Raw run status while still running

schemaValid.description: With output_schema: whether the answer data matched it

shownChars.description: Characters returned in the text content

status.description: completed, partial, running, waiting, failed, … or error

totalChars.description: Characters in the full answer or page text

truncated.description: True when maxChars cut the text short

title: Run a goal-based browsing task
